sequence.title: Scope, applicability and accountable design roles
sequence.development_action: Record exact intended attraction/vehicles/site use and applicable approvals; establish named design/acceptance roles. Prepare unsent technical requests only.
sequence.not_released: No presumed FRA/amusement/building exemption or shop/operation permission.

sequence.title: Ground-level occupied layout review
sequence.development_action: Use existing3E regular/accessible layouts, six-adult review and real mobility devices; record coats/knees/door hardware/turning/companion and supervised evacuation-layout observations.
sequence.not_released: Mockup is nonstructural and not installed lift/stair or vehicle acceptance.

sequence.title: Controlled physical interface definition
sequence.development_action: Freeze actual source geometry and loads/motions, supported fits/joints, component revisions and service envelopes; coordinate custom whole truck, coach and locomotive.
sequence.not_released: No guessed mount sizes or selected-spring claims from sensitivity inputs.

sequence.title: Released coupon / fixture / manufacturing plan
sequence.development_action: Apply J-TR01..09 to accepted exact production-material specimens/fixtures; material traceability, process qualification, fit-up/weld/NDT hold points and approved guarded test plan.
sequence.not_released: No structural load or stored-energy test before protocol/limits/fixture authorization.

sequence.title: Component and connection qualification
sequence.development_action: Accepted exact brake maps, wheel/axle/hub manufacture/retention evidence, seat/floor coupons and articulated coupling/guide/support joints; retain anomalies and revisions.
sequence.not_released: Proof test does not establish fatigue life or release other geometry.

sequence.title: Complete first custom truck and frame
sequence.development_action: Integrate actual wheels/axleboxes/springs/dampers/guides/stops/pivot/sidebearers/D1supports, revised frame details and full inspection; validate wheel loads/twist/motion and service access.
sequence.not_released: DisplayG1 and J1a member-only model do not satisfy this stage.

sequence.title: Integrated first regular and accessible vehicles
sequence.development_action: Separate body/support/layout configurations; route actual hoses/cables/guards, emergency exits/lighting, roof equipment and boarding mechanisms; capture as-built mass/CG and datums.
sequence.not_released: Accessible coach requires its own installation/structural acceptance, not regular-car inference.

sequence.title: Site proof section and station interfaces
sequence.development_action: Approve actual profile/formation/drainage/track/joint/fastening section and stations. Crew records each released installation hold point; survey measured as-built geometry and correct defects.
sequence.not_released: Do not lay selected rail/joints or set station level from unaccepted CAD/floor datum.

sequence.title: Secured pneumatic, power and control integration
sequence.development_action: Revised E03..06/E10..12 and20Kstates under approved safe fixtures; actual complete air/power configuration, reserve/timing/separation/anti-compounding and return-to-safe state.
sequence.not_released: No live hose cutting, unrestrained spring release or arbitrary field fault injection.

sequence.title: Controlled unoccupied vehicle and full-consist trials
sequence.development_action: Before full-consist trials, all3regular coaches plus1accessible coach and locomotive need separately released fabrication/configuration and qualified as-built evidence, including the two additional regular coaches not covered by the first-coach stage. Engineer-approved tare/ballast sequence and containment, stopping/holding/adhesion/thermal/air-duty, drawbar/articulation/wheel-load and drive cooling/exhaust tests; actual every-vehicle records.
sequence.not_released: No passengers or public operation; accepted limits/abort/directions/degraded states must be explicit. First-coach qualification does not release repeat vehicles.

sequence.title: Installed boarding and supervised emergency exercises
sequence.development_action: E14 installed equipment qualification first, then E13 participant exercise under approved protocol, actual both stations and off-station rescue access/communications.
sequence.not_released: No participant loading of unqualified equipment or unsafe injected failure.

sequence.title: Configuration freeze and conditional operational handover
sequence.development_action: Disposition actual evidence and all applicable critical gates; approved manuals/staff/training/inspection/maintenance/defect limits, route dispatch, emergency and signed acceptance records.
sequence.not_released: Publication is not release. Repeat fleet fabrication and second-train operation require separate configuration/review permissions.

note: Overlapping engineering research and survey preparation are allowed. Related gate IDs are traceability subjects, NOT a requirement to close whole-train approval gates before separately authorized component qualification. Each stage needs its own accepted scope and safe method; scoped evidence cannot release the complete train. This is conservative evidence release order, not a construction schedule or approved field method. No durations, starts, lead times, dates or financial commitments are invented.
